title: Chapter 192 - 192 Miss Out On 100 Million?
content:
Chapter 192 - 192 Miss Out On 100 Million?

Chapter 192 - 192 Miss Out On 100 Million?

192 Miss Out On 100 Million?

Jiangbei East Station was the largest railway station in Jiangbei and also the hub of the country.

Every day, more than 100,000 people would get on and off the trains here.

In addition to the people who picked them up…

There were hundreds of thousands of people at Jiangbei East Station every day!

It could be said that East Station was filled with people at all times.

After Lin Fan parked the car, he stood at the exit with many people.

Not long after, a crisp shout sounded from the large crowd.

“Brother! I’m here!”

Then, Lin Xiaoyao, a quiet little girl wearing pink glasses, and a girl with a mid-part hairstyle who looked like a little adult walked over quickly.

“Let me introduce you guys. This is my brother, Lin Fan! He’s studying at Jiangbei University, and he’s still single!” Lin Xiaoyao chuckled.

When Lin Fan heard that, he almost choked.

This little girl… Could it be that she wanted to introduce her two friends to him?

Two high school girls?

Lin Fan subconsciously used his Eyes of Truth to observe the two of them.

The quiet little girl…

[Appearance: 85]

[Favorability: 40]

The girl who looked like a little adult…

[Appearance: 84]

[Favorability: 40]

Their looks did not even hit 90, and their favorability toward him was at the level of a passerby.

His women all scored above 90 points.

How could he have any ideas about them?

Of course, the main reason was that he already had a girlfriend!

Yes, that was it!

Lin Xiaoyao pointed at the quiet girl and said, “This is Tang Jiao.”

Then, she pointed at the girl who looked like a little adult and said, “This is Du Yujia.”

Lin Fan nodded politely as a form of greeting.

“You guys should be hungry, right? Let’s go and eat something first.”

“I want to eat Jiangbei’s hot dry noodles! And glutinous rice chicken!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly.

“Okay!” Lin Fan replied and led them to the parking lot.

Soon, everyone arrived in front of the Mercedes-Benz.

Girls did not know much about cars.

Moreover, Tang Jiao and Du Yujia were only high school students, so they were even more unclear.

However, when they looked at the tall and sturdy appearance of the Mercedes-Benz G, they could not help but reveal a hint of surprise on their faces.

Boom!

Lin Fan stepped on the accelerator, and the car sped forward like a ferocious beast.

Tang Jiao and Du Yujia felt the powerful driving force of the Mercedes-Benz G-Class… As a result, they had a good impression of Lin Fan.

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket vibrated.

12 pm!

The red packets were here!

Hence, Lin Fan slammed on the brakes.

Then, he turned the steering wheel and parked the car in a temporary parking space by the roadside.

He quickly picked up his phone and kept tapping on the red packets.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten yuan.]

…

Lin Xiaoyao asked curiously, “Brother, what are you doing?”

“Oh, I’m snatching red packets,” Lin Fan replied.

Lin Xiaoyao was speechless.

Tang Jiao was speechless.

Du Yujia was speechless.

The three of them were speechless.

Snatching red packets?

If they remembered correctly, a red packet was only 200 yuan at most, right?

That was the most!

Under normal circumstances, it would only be a few yuan or even a few cents, right?

This…

Why was he so agitated?

If others did not know, they would think that he was about to miss out on 100 million yuan.

Initially, Tang Jiao and Du Yujia had a good impression of Lin Fan.

At this moment, it had completely vanished.

Lin Xiaoyao smiled in embarrassment.

Lin Fan’s lips curled up into a smile.

That was because Lin Fan had just received 10% of Weibo’s shares from a red packet!

One had to know…

Weibo was a huge enterprise with a market value of hundreds of billions!

10% of the shares were worth more than ten billion!

If only Lin Fan knew what Tang Jiao and Du Yujia were thinking.

He would probably tell them that if he had missed out on these red packets just now, he would not have just missed out on 100 million yuan.

It was ten billion!

Then, Lin Fan started the car again and sped toward Cai Ji.

Cai Ji Restaurant was indeed a famous snack bar in Jiangbei.

The upper and lower floors were packed. It was extremely lively.

Lin Xiaoyao and the others ordered hot dry noodles, glutinous rice chicken, steamed dumplings, and many other specialties. They ate very happily, and their stomachs began to expand.

“Where do you want to go next?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yujia said she just finished her exams and wants to buy a bag to reward herself,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“Oh? What about you? Do you want to buy one as a reward?” Lin Fan continued to ask.

“Why would I want a bag? It’s so tiring to carry it every day.” Lin Xiaoyao waved her hands.

Lin Fan did not force it and asked, “Where do you want to go to buy a bag?”

“MK Mall! I want to buy a Gucci bag!” Du Yujia said hurriedly.

When Lin Fan heard this, a weird look appeared on his face.

MK Mall?

Was that not his own mall?

Speaking of which, he had not entered the mall since the last time he obtained it.

As for the Gucci bag?

He even owned 5% of Gucci’s shares.

Du Yujia thought that Lin Fan was wondering where she got the money to buy such a high-end bag. She explained, “It’s my pocket money.”

Lin Fan nodded his head casually. Then, he drove the few of them to MK Mall with ease.

When Lin Fan arrived at the elevator, a middle-aged man in a suit walked over.

“Mr. Lin!” he said excitedly.

“You are…” Lin Fan asked curiously.

“I’m the general manager of MK Mall, Yuan Hong!” The middle-aged man did not feel unhappy at all when Lin Fan did not recognize him.

On the contrary, there was a hint of respect in his excited tone.

It was no wonder that he would be like this.

After all, Lin Fan was the boss of MK. A single word from him could make him pack up and leave!

“Oh, so it’s you, Manager Yuan,” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, are you here for the year-end meeting today?” asked Yuan Hong.

“No, I’m here today because my sister’s classmate wants to buy a bag,” Lin Fan said.

After a pause, he seemed to feel that as the boss, he had never held a meeting.

It could even be said that he did not manage the mall at all, which was a dereliction of duty.

Thus, Lin Fan said, “It’s mainly because I’m in a rush today.”

Ding!

At this moment, the elevator arrived.

Yuan Hong was like the most considerate waiter. He bent down and personally blocked the elevator door. Under Lin Fan’s instructions, he pressed the button for the fourth floor.

Tang Jiao and Du Yujia were dumbfounded.

The middle-aged man in front of them was the general manager of MK?

Why was he so polite to Lin Xiaoyao’s brother?

Since Yuan Hong was still beside them, they could not ask directly. They could only look at Lin Xiaoyao with puzzled eyes.

Obviously, they wanted to draw a conclusion from her.

However, Lin Xiaoyao only shook her head, indicating that she was not sure either.
